purpose: Source-grounded diagnostic for WHY candidates by Experience; no runtime evaluation or evidence authority

reviewNotes: Prefer explicit cheese referent without prior WHICH credit
Preserve interrogative dialogue as grammar exercise, not direct reason-answer
Do not require HOW menu to unlock WHY
Approve scenario-distinct transfer before contract changes
S2 reason and S3 dinner reason share prepared-together semantics; transfer distinctness needs human examination
S3 remains valid independent WHY origin, not silently downgraded to transfer
A dual-role Experience would require explicit contract/attempt mode discrimination
Keep current S3→S4 function/local/transfer contract and existing scope/evidence unchanged

futurePolicy.independentEntry: Each candidate WHY QW must have explicitly approved per-Experience evaluation authority; visits, QW switches and presentation cannot grant it
futurePolicy.semanticPrerequisite: Scene-specific referent and causal contrast are needed; prior WHICH/HOW assessment is not prerequisite
futurePolicy.transfer: Separate explicit transfer approval and genuinely distinct contextual reasoning; no route/visit obligation
futurePolicy.evidence: Only observed learner answer, canonical scope, authored probe/result and validated contract can produce evidence
futurePolicy.scope: learnerId × skill × language × originExperienceId; preserve retained scopes, do not relabel S3 as S1 or S2
futurePolicy.timeModes: PRESENT/PAST/FUTURE × AFFIRMATIVE/NEGATIVE/INTERROGATIVE require mode-appropriate reasoning; grammatical transformation is not causal response
futurePolicy.masterVip: Master VIP authoritatively supplies QW/word types and THERE + TO BE / EXISTENCE; latter is independent verb function, not a WHY shortcut
futurePolicy.view: HOW TO SHOW displays only verified current context and evidence; 0/4 contextual suitability is distinct from 0/3 Green Pass progress
